display_name: LoRa W24 9–32 kHz 逐频点幅相与回写量归因（Full）
description: Separate coefficient phase, relative coefficient magnitude and edit energy in the 9–32 kHz band.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal authorizes strictly isolated source diagnostics with simulated noise components. Latest user instruction limits this experiment to Full practical.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Prior frozen exact source-packet replay and original same-packet clean/direct/half coordinates.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean; source-only isolated trace.

permissions.claim_scope: Zero training, model selection or target paths. Exact noise consumed solely by diagnostic counterfactuals after frozen-source model binding. Full route only.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original compliant frozen source models, no dynamic weights, no training or calibration.
checkpoint.selection_rule: No tuning, deployment or candidate selection. A positive RX-stratified paired interval on six scenes or low urban identifies a signal for a future separate source experiment.

execution.gpu_policy: One GPU, 0 then 3, 5, 6; require at least 12 GiB free and under eight visible compute contexts; eight CPU replay workers.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on input, parent, Full replay, energy parity, coverage or frozen previous joint-reference label parity failure.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_edit_budget_audit score-source and the existing frozen source scorer

rows.method: Direct, frozen half, phase-only, amplitude-only, same-energy joint and exact band-energy joint in 9-32 kHz.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: One fixed 300-packet panel, seven Full views, zero fitting or calibration.

notes: Both 9–32 kHz sidebands in the 384-point observed-phase frame. Hold the DC, other bins and all native edge IQ fixed.

Phase changes one complex coefficient angle at fixed learned magnitude. Amplitude keeps its learned phase and changes relative magnitudes with per-packet normalization. Joint matched uses the learned total band energy. Exact band dose isolates the effect of allowing the oracle amplitude without that constraint.
Zero noise reproduces the frozen half clean. The same-energy joint reproduces the previous source diagnostic decisions. No target or new fitting.
